svg.aria-label: Lumen Surface Cache: material layers (albedo / normal / emissive / depth)
svg.title: Lumen Surface Cache: material layers (albedo / normal / emissive / depth)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen Surface Cache: material layers (albedo / normal / emissive / depth) graph 0001 | mapped-page crop (0, 0, 1104, 144) | 42 mapped pages, 35072 common texels ALBEDO (sqrt-decoded) CARD-SPACE NORMAL EMISSIVE (HDR) SURFACE-CACHE DEPTH mapped physical page texel off-page/unmapped (masked) emissive HDR (shared scale 1) nonfinite (should be 0 here) Occupancy is decoded from Lumen.PageBuffer (5 float4/page): mapped test SizeInTexels.x>0 and .y>0; PhysicalAtlasCoord = uint2(PhysicalAtlasUVRect.xy * 4096 + 0.5), max corner from .zw. Unmapped/stale pages are masked navy, not decoded as data (source schema resource.lumen-card-page-data). The four panels share one exact occupancy mask and one 1:1 crop; the crop is the mapped-page bbox plus 16 texels. No panel uses its own nonzero test. Lumen.SceneAlbedo: DecodeSurfaceCacheAlbedo squares the stored sqrt(albedo); DiffuseColorBoost is a material parameter not present in the payload and is not applied (LumenSurfaceCache.ush:44-47). Lumen.SceneNormal: BC5 stores card-space normal.xy*0.5+0.5; the figure reconstructs z=sqrt(1-x^2-y^2) and displays N*0.5+0.5 (card space, not world) (LumenSurfaceCache.ush:25-33). Lumen.SceneEmissive: linear HDR; every mapped texel is exactly zero in this capture (stats.emissive.valid_nonzero = 0), so the panel is intentionally black. Lumen.SceneDepth: PF_G16 / 65535; 1.0 is the EncodeSurfaceCacheDepth invalid sentinel and is categorical blue.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
